A circular component with a central opening, stepped bores and a pattern of smaller holes.

Typical geometry
Central opening, stepped bores, face holes and machined circular surfaces.
Material options
aluminum, stainless and carbon steel, copper, brass, titanium and engineering plastics.
Key review
Bore sizes and face-hole positions need a common reference to the circular faces.
Request a quote

Have a drawing? Add it to your inquiry email.

Manufacturing options
Materials
Material options: aluminum, stainless and carbon steel, copper, brass, titanium and engineering plastics.
Machining
3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis CNC milling.
Surface finish
As-machined, polishing, bead blasting, Type II or Type III anodizing, and plating; select a treatment compatible with the material.

Made to order. Your approved drawing and quotation define the specification; the image is not a material certificate, dimensional record or inspection result.

Drawing and
inspection requirements
Quality & inspection
Geometry & interfaces
Specify bore diameters, step depths and fits. Locate the face-hole pattern from drawing datums, including pitch-circle diameter or hole-center coordinates and the relationship to the central bore.
Material & finish
Specify the material grade, condition, finish and any masked areas.
Quantity
State the prototype or batch quantity and required schedule.
Inspection requirements
Agree diameter and depth checks for each bore step, hole-position checks and the flatness or orientation of functional circular faces. Define the inspection setup from the drawing datums.
Prepare an RFQ email

From 1 piece · 7–14 business days
From drawing and order confirmation, including surface finishing; transit is additional.
